episodes.name: 64 counties: the state coordinator against NatureSwarm (second version)
episodes.about: PandemicEnv, the 64 counties nearest Dallas County, Texas: 16 testing teams and an alert budget of 576 county-days over 90 days. The state coordinator and the second version of NatureSwarm (design swarm2), both run by Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, beside the detection program, which follows fixed rules and uses no language model. Stored episodes of the registered confirmation study (stage P5), seed 301. Variant infections by day 90 against no action on the same seed: state coordinator 57.2% fewer, NatureSwarm (second version) 76.7% fewer, detection program 79.8% fewer.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered confirmation study (paper_nc/notes/prereg_pandemic_P5.md, stage P5), written as traces by the exporter of the PandemicEnv viewer (scripts/pandemic_viewer.py); no model is called. Seed 301: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds (300 to 302).
episodes.takeaway: The state coordinator, the second version of NatureSwarm and a detection program on the same region and seed. Variant infections by day 90 against no action, left to right: 57.2% fewer, 76.7% fewer, 79.8% fewer.

episodes.name: 64 counties: the state coordinator, NatureSwarm and a detection program
episodes.about: A faster variant enters through the airport counties around Dallas and Fort Worth. Each design moves 16 testing teams along commuting links and spends a shared budget of 576 alert-days. The state coordinator decides for every county at once; NatureSwarm's counties decide for themselves and act only on first-hand evidence; the detection program follows fixed rules and uses no language model.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered main study (paper_nc/notes/prereg_pandemic_main.md, stage P1). Seed 202: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.
episodes.takeaway: The state coordinator decides for every county at once; NatureSwarm's counties decide for themselves and act only on first-hand evidence. Variant infections by day 90 against no action, left to right: 8.2% more, 57.0% fewer, 56.5% fewer.

episodes.takeaway: The coordinator still writes one order sheet for all 256 counties each day. Variant infections by day 90 against no action, left to right: 58.5% fewer, 60.5% fewer, 73.3% fewer.

episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered main study (paper_nc/notes/prereg_pandemic_main.md, stage P1). Seed 201: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.

episodes.name: 64 counties: NatureSwarm's evidence mechanism given to the coordinator
episodes.about: The middle panel is the same state coordinator with one change: its alerts take effect only where a county's own teams or sequencing found the variant, or where two of its commuting partners did, as honeybee scouts recruit only to sites they have inspected. This mechanism, more than deciding county by county, explains most of NatureSwarm's advantage up to 64 counties.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered mechanism check (paper_nc/notes/prereg_pandemic_P3.md) beside the P1 episodes of the same seed. Seed 202: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.
episodes.takeaway: Middle panel: the same state coordinator, whose alerts take effect only where a county's own teams or sequencing found the variant, or where two of its commuting partners did. Variant infections by day 90 against no action, left to right: 8.2% more, 61.5% fewer, 57.0% fewer.

episodes.name: 1,024 counties: the evidence mechanism with and without decentralization
episodes.about: Both designs follow the same evidence mechanism. At 1,024 counties, NatureSwarm's counties decide locally while the coordinator must still write every order.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered mechanism check (paper_nc/notes/prereg_pandemic_P3.md) beside the P1 episodes of the same seed. Seed 201: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.
episodes.takeaway: Both designs follow the same evidence mechanism; NatureSwarm's counties decide locally while the coordinator must still write every order. Variant infections by day 90 against no action, left to right: 52.6% fewer, 61.8% fewer.

episodes.name: The state goes silent for 14 days (64 counties)
episodes.about: From day 20 to day 33 the state coordinator gives no orders; counties keep their teams and alerts. NatureSwarm has no centre to lose.
episodes.method: Stored episodes of the registered main study (stage P2) beside the P1 episodes of the same seed. Seed 202: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.

episodes.name: A coordinator that decides once a week against one that decides daily
episodes.about: The same coordinator and model, deciding every day (left) or only on days 0, 7, 14 and so on (right). Deciding less often, it spends less of its alert budget before the variant is found, and its teams spend fewer days on the road.

episodes.name: No action: the variant spreads unchecked (64 counties)
episodes.about: Left: teams test where they start and no alert is raised. Right: the oracle, which sees true infections and keeps its alerts on the counties with the most variant infections, paced over the 90 days. Every other design lies between the two.
episodes.method: Stored rule episodes of the registered main study (stage P1). Seed 205: the seed whose reductions lie closest to each design's mean over the candidate seeds.
episodes.takeaway: Left: teams test where they start and no alert is raised. Right: the oracle, which sees true infections. Every other design lies between the two. Variant infections by day 90 against no action: 90.9% fewer with the oracle.
